column2: More salvage dumped from Zalem... nothing intact in this storm.
Alita. Come here. All of Sector 4 is saying your name now. You gave this city something it hasn't had in years.
I only fought. You are the one who rebuilt me, Ido.
Listen. The people who made your core are not gone. They answer to one man, a cyborg called SwitchBlade. He runs everything in this city's shadow.
I should have told you sooner. He will come for you now that the whole district knows what you are. Stay close and...
Doctor Ido. You hid her well. Not well enough.
Alita... your core... they can never erase who you are. Run... live... and finish what I could not.
The Pit's new champion. A shame about the doctor. Rest, little ghost. Your core is mine, and so is this city.
Ido... SwitchBlade. I will find you, and I will end you.
Combat telemetry confirmed. All three corrupted enforcer cores have suffered total shutdown. The bridge corridor is clear.
Your reaction times and motor sync exceeded my calculations... that combat instinct wasn't built in any Scrapyard clinic.
Catch your breath, Alita. The lower district is open to explore, but keep your guard up.
Alita... if you are decrypting this emergency cache, the Factory hit squads found us on the bridge.
They can never erase who you are. A Razor scalper right here by the bridge is flashing a spare Pit pass.
Take the pass with your blade. Enter the Pit arena... and find who ordered the strike.
